title: GitHub Pages board (live view + editing via GitHub API)
description: Static page on GitHub Pages that reads the taskboard branch through the GitHub API and, with a token, edits it with the same CAS semantics as the CLI. Share task logic between CLI and page so they cannot drift.

steps.text: Extract pure core (ops, merge, render) from tb.mjs
Add board.json to board tree for 1-request loading

log.msg: Pure core extracted into makeCore(rand) in tb.mjs (ops = C.apply.*, merge, renderBoardMd, boardJson/fromBoardJson). Board tree now also has board.json (all tasks, 1 file). Added test/cli.test.sh (all pass). Next: backend abstraction in the UI block.

Pages backend done: embedded block __GH__ in tb.mjs (GitHub API reads via board.json/raw, writes via git data API with non-force ref PATCH = CAS, 8 retries), settings dialog, read-only mode, tb pages command writes docs/index.html + .nojekyll. UI now uses a backend object (local server or window.TB_BACKEND). test/pages.test.py + test/mock-github.mjs: all pass incl. conflict retry and legacy boards. Next: test against real api.github.com, README, push.

Pushed to main (9a15ba8): tb pages, docs/index.html, tests, README section. Verified read-only against real api.github.com for this repo, desktop + 390px mobile. Remaining: Jannis must enable Pages (Settings → Pages → main /docs) and try editing with a fine-grained token; real-API editing is only tested against the mock.
